summary: Iter-26 end-to-end verification of DB-backed Jobs Master (GET /api/jobs + /api/admin/jobs CRUD + bulk-replace) and inline roster-add endpoints (/employees/add, /suppliers/add). Added pytest suite test_jobs_master_and_roster_iter26.py (13 pass, 1 documented skip). Verified AdminJobMasterPanel UI at /admin: 28 seeded jobs render with correct columns; inline Add/Update, toggle-active dim row, delete with confirm mock, and Bulk-Replace dialog all work. JobPicker on /daily/new opens to show 29 options (28 seeded jobs + Custom). Cleaned up all TEST_ rows before finishing.

critical.issue: Upsert regenerates the `id` UUID on every update because the frontend form never passes `id` back and jobs_master.py _normalize() falls through to str(uuid.uuid4()) which is then written via $set. Consequence: any stored reference (including the `id` just returned to AdminJobMasterPanel or a row that was rendered before the admin hit Add/Update again) becomes stale, so subsequent PATCH /api/admin/jobs/{id}/active or DELETE /api/admin/jobs/{id} returns 404. Repro: POST twice with same project_number and compare ids — they differ. Fix: in _normalize separate insert-only fields (id, created_at) from mutable fields, or rewrite upsert_job to use $setOnInsert for id/created_at and $set only for the mutable fields.

minor.issue: Validation for empty project_number returns 422 (Pydantic min_length=1) while empty project_name falls through to the jobs_master.upsert_job ValueError -> 400. Inconsistent status code for the same class of error. Acceptable since both reject, but consider unifying.

action_items: Fix POST /api/admin/jobs upsert so the `id` of an existing job is not regenerated. In /app/backend/jobs_master.py upsert_job, switch the update_one call to use $set for mutable fields + $setOnInsert for {id: new_uuid, created_at: now}. Without this, toggling active / deleting immediately after an Add/Update in the admin panel is a latent 404 bug.
(Optional) Normalise validation: trim project_number/project_name in JobIn or the route so empty-after-trim is consistently rejected with 400.
critical_code_review_comments: jobs_master.py::_normalize() treats id as if it's part of the updatable payload — breaks upsert semantics. `id` and `created_at` should be insert-only.
AdminJobMasterPanel posts form without `id` even for update flow. Once backend is fixed this is fine; otherwise UI should pass `id` back when editing an existing row.

rca of the issue: Upsert bug RCA — /app/backend/jobs_master.py:91 upsert_job -> _normalize(body) at line 93 generates a fresh uuid because the request body from AdminJobMasterPanel never carries `id`. Then update_one(..., {'$set': doc}, upsert=True) writes that fresh uuid every call, silently mutating the primary key. Mitigation: split payload into {update_fields, insert_fields={'id': ..., 'created_at': ...}} and call update_one(..., {'$set': update_fields, '$setOnInsert': insert_fields}, upsert=True). Alternative: include `id` in the AdminJobMasterPanel form submission for update flow and have _normalize preserve whatever comes in.
